channel.title: Rates & Inflation Morning Brief
channel.description: The morning intelligence for rates, inflation & govies desks — yields, spreads, curve, CB radar, macro data, and actionable trade ideas before the open

item.title: Data calendar, surprises, and today's catalysts
item.description: With ISM Services at 55.3 and Hormuz unresolved, the desk faces a contradiction: hawkish repricing from strong data meets risk-off undertones from energy risks. The skew remains toward higher yields, but the tail risk is non-trivial. Stay flexible.

item.title: ISM Services PMI : Le test crucial pour les marchés
item.description: The Hormuz crisis has markets caught in a contradiction. The inflationary shock from the energy blockade is forcing a hawkish repricing of central bank policy, sending yields soaring. Simultaneously, the profound geopolitical risk is creating a tense, risk-off environment where any further escalation could trigger a paradoxical flight-to-quality rally. Today's brief unpacks this tug-of-war.

item.title: GDP, PCE & ECB Decision Day: A Triple-Threat Thursday
item.description: Triple threat Thursday: Fed's 8-4 hawkish split meets ECB decision day, with Q1 GDP and PCE dropping at 8:30 AM ET. Hormuz enters month 3. The skew is unambiguously to higher yields — the only question is speed.

item.title: FOMC Day: Fed Expected to Hold as Markets Watch for Hawkish Shift
item.description: Dual CB week: Fed holds today, ECB meets tomorrow. With CPI at 3.3%, Hormuz closed Day 61, and BTP-Bund at 82bp, the skew is hawkish. The desk goes into Wednesday short duration and long vol.

item.title: Fed & ECB Week: Quiet Data Calendar Before the Storm
item.description: Triple CB week kicks off with oil at 08 and Hormuz on day 60. The desk goes into Wednesday short Schatz and long vol — the ECB is the most likely source of a market surprise.

item.title: Central Bank Super-Week: 7 Decisions in 72 Hours + Q1 GDP + PCE
item.description: Une semaine décisive pour les banques centrales s'ouvre, avec 7 décisions en 72 heures. Le Conseil a validé 11 trades, dont le steepener UST 2s10s et le tightener BTP-Bund. Le marché reste suspendu à la situation à Hormuz et aux données d'inflation.

item.title: Durable Goods & UMich Final in Focus — Hormuz Fog Clouds All
item.description: Hormuz Day 56 and the inflation afterburner is firing on all cylinders. ECB holds next Thursday but the IMF's +50bp call for 2026 is the elephant in the room. BTP-Bund at 79bp — periphery stress is the trade. The desk goes into the weekend long spread, long breakevens.

item.title: Flash PMI Day: EZ Slides Into Contraction as US Manufacturing Surges — Stagflation Trade Goes Global
item.description: PMI divergence day. The Eurozone just printed its worst composite reading in 17 months while US manufacturing surged to a near-4-year high. This isn't just a data surprise — it's a structural split that redefines CB policy paths, curve trades, and cross-currency positioning for the quarter. The council retained 15 of 24 trades, with the ECB-Fed 2Y spread and Bund steepener as top conviction.
